d: A golden-armored entity with glowing white eyes and a flame-like crest of golden-yellow hair. Non-human traits include a helmeted face with curved horns and a lack of visible human skin, replaced by a golden metallic sheen. BODY COLOR: Golden LEGS: Not visible
